status: thirteenth aggregation slice: the order receipt is asked whether the term already satisfies it before rebuilding, capturing exactly the 1,276 wasted walks on NovyWave and cutting the order phase 40%

change.what: retain_requirement_order now asks requirement_order_matches(previous, current) first. That predicate mirrors the walk's semantics — objects must already list the surviving fields in the receipt's relative order with new-only fields after them, variant sets only reorder nested payloads, and list/set/map/function recurse — and returns the current term untouched when it holds, skipping the rebuilt field list, the interpretation of every field name and the final comparison.
change.why: counters showed the walk almost never changes anything: NovyWave 634 identity returns, 1,276 rebuilds that reproduce the current term and 29 real changes across 1,305 walks (TodoMVC 1,330/1,643/1) against a 12.4 ms order phase.
change.soundness: the predicate is a structural restatement of what the walk rebuilds, and debug builds still run the walk and assert that it returns the same term whenever the fast path claims a match, so every gate exercises the claim.

phase_probe_release.note: the early-match counts equal the previously measured no-op walk counts exactly, which is the intended effect; single observations per build

paired_ab.protocol: twelve rounds per cell, both binaries back to back with alternating order, one process per observation
paired_ab.reading: the 7.6 ms phase saving is partly probe-timer removal and the end-to-end reading is small and near the host's noise floor; the slice is kept on the work it removes (1,276 full receipt walks per compile) and the byte-identical results

position: NovyWave's refresh is ~64 ms: contributor check 15.0, merge 13.1, order 7.4, deps 4.9, collection/invalidation/commit ~5.5 and the rest bookkeeping. The contributor check and merge are the only buckets left above 10 ms, and both are now doing genuine work for the changed contributors.
caveats: end-to-end effect is inside the noise floor; the phase and counter evidence is the claim
cold modes only; the warm path is the successor goal
